comparator.name: UCR Liberal Arts and Sciences
comparator.sourceNotes: The current UCR curriculum is a flexible 180-EC Liberal Arts and Sciences bachelor rather than one fixed course sequence. Students complete 24 courses of 7.5 EC. Personal & Professional Development is the only mandatory first-year course. At least six courses must be at 300 level and contain research components; students may instead replace two advanced courses with a third-year Research Seminar that includes a bachelor thesis. The remaining 17 courses are chosen across six academic clusters, subject to prerequisites and coherent progression. A digital Liberal Arts & Sciences Portfolio is also required but carries no separate EC. The generic normalized target names no academic field, BA/BSc outcome or cluster-specific major, so no route is selected and the 172.5 EC of student-designed course choice is preserved as restricted/open choice rather than populated with invented subjects. The three UCR columns then show valid concrete examples of how that same flexible degree can be instantiated.
components: At least six 300-level courses, each containing a research component; alternatively four 300-level courses plus a Research Seminar.
Seventeen further 7.5-EC courses selected from the six academic clusters, subject to prerequisites and coherent progression.

core: A student-designed Liberal Arts and Sciences curriculum combining sciences, social sciences and humanities
Breadth with progressive depth across introductory, intermediate and advanced study
Research, critical thinking, communication and reflective academic development
adjacent: Data science, computer science, mathematics and intelligent systems
Environment, sustainability, ecology and delta challenges
Government, law, history, philosophy and society
Health, cognition, psychology, behaviour and life science
Media, culture, communication, literature and heritage
questions: How can perspectives from different disciplines illuminate complex social problems?
How can data, computation and intelligent systems help address real problems?
How do health, environment, institutions, culture and enterprise shape human futures?

alternatives.label: Liberal Arts & Sciences: Society, Science & Culture
alternatives.labelReason: The completed curriculum draws substantially from all six UCR clusters and combines social inquiry, science, data, business, health, media and sustainability rather than presenting one cluster as the entire degree.
alternatives.concept: A broad illustration of UCR Liberal Arts and Sciences combining all six academic clusters around complex societal questions, with methods, communication and progressive advanced research across science, social science and humanities.
progression: Introductory gateway, methods and communication courses precede advanced environmental governance, psychology, leadership, data, politics, cognition, media and research. PPD is in Year 1, all prerequisites and term availability are satisfied, and ten 300-level courses provide advanced depth.

alternatives.label: Business Strategy, Markets & Entrepreneurship
alternatives.labelReason: The completed curriculum is dominated by business foundations, entrepreneurship, finance, economics, leadership, marketing and organisational decisions, with data and programming support.
alternatives.concept: A cluster-led Liberal Arts and Sciences programme in business and entrepreneurship, integrating economics, finance, strategy, marketing, leadership, research methods, data and programming.
progression: Entrepreneurship, business research, economics, finance, leadership, programming and data foundations precede upper-level strategy, markets, organisational decision-making and econometrics. Formal prerequisites and Fall-2026 cohort availability are satisfied.
alternatives.distinctness: This programme replaces most of the broad alternative’s health, environment, politics, history and media sequence with sustained entrepreneurship, economics, finance, strategy, marketing and leadership study, changing well over 30 EC.

alternatives.label: Data Science, AI & Autonomous Systems
alternatives.labelReason: The curriculum contains a sustained sequence in programming, databases, algorithms, machine learning, deep learning, reinforcement learning, optimisation, robotics, mathematics and statistics.
alternatives.concept: A cluster-led Liberal Arts and Sciences programme in data science and intelligent systems, combining programming, algorithms, machine learning, neural networks, optimisation, robotics, mathematical modelling, statistics, ethics and communication.
progression: Research, mathematics, data and database foundations precede programming-intensive software, robotics, algorithms, optimisation, reinforcement learning and deep learning. Programming and Mathematical Methods precede every formal dependent, and all courses are offered in their assigned term.
alternatives.distinctness: This programme replaces the business alternative’s economics, finance, marketing, leadership and organisational strategy sequence with sustained programming, algorithms, machine learning, neural networks, robotics, optimisation and mathematics, changing well over 30 EC.

blocks: The comparator requirement is a 45-EC restricted choice across advanced UCR courses; each displayed alternative instantiates it with at least six 300-level courses.
The generic comparator deliberately preserves 127.5 EC of student-designed choice rather than pretending every UCR student follows one fixed set of courses.
The same mandatory Personal & Professional Development course appears in the comparator rules and every displayed UCR programme.

selection.assessment: The closest match owns the two generic programme-wide interests and demonstrates the defining cross-cluster Liberal Arts and Sciences model. All remaining generator-eligible interests are assigned to one of the six current official academic clusters. Business & Entrepreneurship and Data Science & Intelligent Systems are considered next in the official cluster order and both pass the evidence, coherence, distinctness and feasibility gates, so they are included as alternatives two and three. Environment & Sustainability, Government & Society, Health, Cognition & Behavior and Media, Culture & Communication are also coherent but cannot be added after the maximum of three alternatives is reached. Every schedule contains exactly 24 courses/180 EC, satisfies prerequisite and term constraints and includes at least six 300-level courses.

notes.text: This normalized target is UCR’s own Liberal Arts and Sciences bachelor. The comparator column therefore shows the generic degree rules and preserves its student-designed choice, while the UCR columns instantiate three concrete valid curricula from the same current course catalogue.

UCR does not prescribe one disciplinary curriculum beyond PPD, advanced-level and portfolio requirements. The 172.5 EC of course choice in the comparator is genuine flexibility, not missing data; the three fixed schedules are illustrative feasible compositions rather than official tracks.
